bullets.text: Microsoft and OpenAI Unite - A non-binding MOU marks the next phase of collaboration between **Microsoft** and **OpenAI**.
Windows 10 Update Released - Build 19045.6388 is now available for **Windows 10** Insiders in the Release Preview Channel.
Windows 11 Build Available - **Windows 11** Build 22631.5982 is released to Insiders, featuring various improvements.
Free Developer Registration - Individual developers can now publish apps on the **Microsoft Store** without onboarding fees.
Flexible Work Update - **Microsoft** updates its flexible work policy to three days a week in the office.
AI in Shopping - **Ask Ralph** introduces AI-powered styling in the Ralph Lauren app, enhancing consumer experience.
Azure MFA Phase 2 - Starting October 2025, **Azure** will enforce multifactor authentication for resource management.
